wc-term-evaporation: Two views of the same sunlit pavement tile show a puddle shrinking over time; an arrow connects the larger puddle to the smaller one.
wc-term-condensation: A cold metal lid sits above a bowl of water. Small liquid droplets cling to the underside of the lid.
wc-term-precipitation: Raindrops fall from a dark cloud onto a grassy field.
wc-term-collection: A stream enters a calm lake in a basin surrounded by green hills.
wc-term-transpiration: A plant is shown with roots below the soil. Blue arrows trace water upward through the plant and out from its leaves.
wc-term-runoff: Rainwater follows small channels down a grassy slope into a stream. Arrows along the surface point downhill.
wc-term-groundwater: A soil cutaway shows plant roots near the surface and blue water filling spaces between rocks deeper underground.
wc-term-vapor: A dish of water sits below clear air. A magnified model shows four widely separated water molecules, each with one red oxygen atom and two white hydrogen atoms.
wc-term-gravity: Rain falls onto a hillside. Bold arrows point straight down and downhill along flowing water.
wc-term-cycle: Arrows form a loop connecting sunlit water, a cloud, rain over a hillside, and a stream.
wc-img-cycle-diagram: A coastal landscape links ocean, clouds, rain, trees, and streams. Arrows rise from water and plants; rain falls on land and streams flow downhill toward the ocean.
wc-img-cloud-droplets: A cloud over a landscape connects to an enlarged circular view of separate round water droplets.
wc-img-glass-condensation: An ice-filled glass stands in a warm kitchen. Droplets coat its outside and a wet ring surrounds its base.
wc-img-groundwater: A landscape cutaway shows a stream above layers of soil and rock. Blue water occupies spaces between deeper rocks, and a well extends into that water-filled layer.
wc-img-puddle-time: Three views of the same pavement show a large puddle, a smaller puddle, and a tiny wet patch.
wc-img-rain-snow: Side-by-side landscapes show liquid rain over green hills and snow falling over snowy mountains. An inset enlarges several ice crystals.
wc-img-breath-fog: A child outdoors in winter exhales a small white mist cloud into the cold air.
wc-img-reservoirs: A landscape shows an ocean, lake, river, and mountain glacier. A foreground cutaway reveals water between underground rocks.
wc-img-root-leaf: Arrows lead from plant roots up its stem. A magnified leaf pore shows two guard cells around an opening, with one arrow pointing outward from the pore.
wc-img-sun-gravity: Two panels contrast sunlight over water with an upward arrow, and rain above a hillside stream with a downward arrow.
wc-img-salt-remains: Two shallow dishes show more water on the left and less water with more exposed salt crystals on the right. An arrow connects the two stages.
wc-img-kettle-gap: A kettle spout opens into a short clear gap. A white mist plume begins farther away from the spout.
wc-img-surface-ground: Rain falls on a sloping soil cutaway. One arrow follows surface water downhill to a stream; two arrows point downward through soil and rock.
wc-img-cloud-ice: A cloud above mountains connects to a magnified view containing both round liquid droplets and angular ice crystals.
